# Pada Design System: full component reference

> Pada (`pada-ds`) is a React design system written in TypeScript: components, CSS design tokens, and light/dark theming. It needs `react` and `react-dom` 19 as peer dependencies.

## Install

```bash
npm install pada-ds
```

## Usage

Import the tokens and the component styles once at the app root, then import components by name from the package root:

```tsx
import 'pada-ds/tokens.css';
import 'pada-ds/styles.css';
import { Button } from 'pada-ds';

<Button variant="primary">Save</Button>
```

- `pada-ds/tokens.css`: design tokens (CSS custom properties, all prefixed `--pada-`) only.
- `pada-ds/tokens`: token names as `var()` strings and breakpoints for JS (`import { tokens, breakpoints } from 'pada-ds/tokens'`); `pada-ds/tokens.scss` and `pada-ds/tokens.json` carry the same tokens for Sass and design tools.
- `pada-ds/styles.css`: styles for every component.
- `pada-ds/headless`: unstyled, accessible parts with no CSS (`Dialog`, `Popover`, `Tooltip`, `DropdownMenu`, plus `Slot`, `Portal`, `VisuallyHidden` and hooks). Compose them as `<Dialog.Root><Dialog.Trigger/><Dialog.Portal><Dialog.Overlay/><Dialog.Content><Dialog.Title/></Dialog.Content></Dialog.Portal></Dialog.Root>`; style them through `data-state`, `data-side` and `aria-*` attributes; `asChild` merges a part onto your own element.
- `pada-ds/base.css` (optional): document base styles (`body` background, color and font; zero `p` margins).
- `pada-ds/manifest.json`: machine-readable component API (props, types, defaults, descriptions).

## Theming

By default the theme follows the operating system (`prefers-color-scheme`). Set `data-theme="light"` or `data-theme="dark"` on `<html>` or on any container to force a theme for that subtree. Remove the attribute to follow the OS again.

More theme axes work the same way and combine freely: `data-accent` (a palette hue such as `indigo`, `amber`, `emerald`, or `custom` with `--pada-accent-hue`), `data-neutral` (`stone`, `slate`, `gray`, `zinc`, `neutral`), `data-density` (`compact`, `comfortable`, `spacious`), `data-radius` (`none`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`), `data-motion` (`reduced`, `full`) and `data-contrast` (`standard`, `more`).

Style custom UI with semantic tokens rather than raw colours: `--pada-color-surface`, `--pada-color-fg`, `--pada-color-fg-muted`, `--pada-color-border`, and per intent (`accent`, `neutral`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`) `--pada-color-<intent>-solid`, `-solid-hover`, `-on-solid`, `-subtle`, `-fg`, `-border`. Spacing is `--pada-space-<n>` (n × 0.25rem × density), radius `--pada-radius-xs` to `-3xl`, motion `--pada-duration-fast|normal|slow` with `--pada-ease-standard|enter|exit|emphasized`, layers `--pada-z-dropdown|modal|popover|toast|tooltip`.

## Components

### Accordion

`import { Accordion } from 'pada-ds';`

Collapsible sections (WAI-ARIA APG Accordion). `<Accordion header="…">` is one standalone section (the 1.x API). For a group, compose the parts: `Accordion.Root` (`type="single"` with optional `collapsible`, or `type="multiple"`), `Accordion.Item`, `Accordion.Trigger` and `Accordion.Content`. Arrow keys and Home/End move between the triggers of a group.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| header | `React.ReactNode` | yes | - | - |
| headerIconName | `string` | no | - | Built-in icon name shown before the header. |
| children | `React.ReactNode` | yes | - | - |
| defaultOpen | `boolean` | no | `false` | - |
| open | `boolean` | no | - | - |
| onOpenChange | `(open: boolean) => void` | no | - | - |
| className | `string` | no | - | - |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | `false` | - |
| headingLevel | `HeadingLevel` | no | `3` | Level of the heading that wraps the header button. |

```tsx
import { Accordion } from 'pada-ds';

<Accordion header="...">...</Accordion>
```

### Accordion.Content

`import { Accordion } from 'pada-ds';`

The section's content; its height animates open and closed.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| forceMount | `boolean` | no | - | Keep the children mounted (with `hidden`) while closed, e.g. to preserve form state. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>`.

```tsx
import { Accordion } from 'pada-ds';

<Accordion.Content />
```

### Accordion.Item

`import { Accordion } from 'pada-ds';`

One section.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | `string` | yes | - | Identifies the item in the root's `value`. |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | - | - |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>`.

```tsx
import { Accordion } from 'pada-ds';

<Accordion.Item value="..." />
```

### Accordion.Root

`import { Accordion } from 'pada-ds';`

Holds which items are open: `type="single"` (optionally `collapsible`) or `type="multiple"`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| type | `'single'` | yes | - | One item open at a time. |
| value | `string` | no | - | Controlled open item (`''` for none). |
| defaultValue | `string` | no | - | Initially open item when uncontrolled. |
| onValueChange | `(value: string) => void` | no | - | Called with the newly open item (`''` when it closed). |
| collapsible | `boolean` | no | - | Let the open item close again, leaving none open. |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | - | Disables every item. |
| orientation | `Orientation` | no | - | Arrow keys follow the orientation: Up/Down when vertical, Left/Right when horizontal. |
| dir | `'ltr' \| 'rtl'` | no | - | Reading direction, for horizontal arrow keys. |

Also accepts the props of `Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>, 'defaultValue' | 'dir'>`.

```tsx
import { Accordion } from 'pada-ds';

<Accordion.Root type="single" />
```

### Accordion.Trigger

`import { Accordion } from 'pada-ds';`

The section's heading and toggle button, with an optional leading icon and a chevron.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| iconName | `string` | no | - | Built-in icon name shown before the title. |
| headingLevel | `HeadingLevel` | no | `3` | Level of the heading that wraps the trigger. |
| asChild | `boolean` | no | - | Merge the trigger's behaviour onto its only child instead of rendering a `<button>`. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'button'>`.

```tsx
import { Accordion } from 'pada-ds';

<Accordion.Trigger />
```

### AccordionContent

`import { AccordionContent } from 'pada-ds';`

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `React.ReactNode` | yes | - | - |

Also accepts the props of `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>`.

```tsx
import { AccordionContent } from 'pada-ds';

<AccordionContent>...</AccordionContent>
```

### AccordionHeader

`import { AccordionHeader } from 'pada-ds';`

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | `React.ReactNode` | yes | - | - |
| iconName | `string` | no | - | - |
| collapsed | `boolean` | no | `true` | - |

Also accepts the props of `Omit<React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'title'>`.

```tsx
import { AccordionHeader } from 'pada-ds';

<AccordionHeader title="..." />
```

### Alert

`import { Alert } from 'pada-ds';`

An inline, persistent message: a callout in a form or page, not a transient toast.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tone | `AlertTone` | no | `'info'` | Colour and default icon by meaning. |
| title | `ReactNode` | no | - | Bold first line. |
| icon | `string \| false` | no | - | Built-in icon name; `false` hides the icon. Defaults to one that matches the tone. |
| actions | `ReactNode` | no | - | Buttons or links shown under the message. |
| onDismiss | `() => void` | no | - | Shows a dismiss button that calls this. |
| live | `'polite' \| 'assertive'` | no | - | Announce the alert when it appears: `polite` (role="status") or `assertive` (role="alert", for errors that need immediate attention). Leave unset for alerts present on page load. |

Also accepts the props of `Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>, 'title'>`.

```tsx
import { Alert } from 'pada-ds';

<Alert />
```

### AlertDialog.Action

`import { AlertDialog } from 'pada-ds';`

The confirming action. Closes the dialog after `onClick`, unless the handler prevents it.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `React.ReactNode` | no | - | - |
| variant | `ButtonVariant` | no | `'primary'` | - |
| size | `ButtonSize` | no | - | Height and padding: sm 28px, md 32px, lg 40px (scaled by density). |
| leftIcon | `string` | no | - | - |
| rightIcon | `string` | no | - | - |
| split | `boolean` | no | - | - |
| onSplitClick | `() => void` | no | - | - |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | - | - |
| loading | `boolean` | no | - | Shows a spinner in place of the label and ignores clicks, keeping the button's width and focus. Announced through `aria-busy`. |
| ref | `React.Ref<HTMLButtonElement>` | no | - | - |

Also accepts the props of `React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>`.

```tsx
import { AlertDialog } from 'pada-ds';

<AlertDialog.Action />
```

### AlertDialog.Cancel

`import { AlertDialog } from 'pada-ds';`

The safe choice. Closes the dialog.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `React.ReactNode` | no | - | - |
| variant | `ButtonVariant` | no | `'secondary'` | - |
| size | `ButtonSize` | no | - | Height and padding: sm 28px, md 32px, lg 40px (scaled by density). |
| leftIcon | `string` | no | - | - |
| rightIcon | `string` | no | - | - |
| split | `boolean` | no | - | - |
| onSplitClick | `() => void` | no | - | - |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | - | - |
| loading | `boolean` | no | - | Shows a spinner in place of the label and ignores clicks, keeping the button's width and focus. Announced through `aria-busy`. |
| ref | `React.Ref<HTMLButtonElement>` | no | - | - |

Also accepts the props of `React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>`.

```tsx
import { AlertDialog } from 'pada-ds';

<AlertDialog.Cancel />
```

### AlertDialog.Content

`import { AlertDialog } from 'pada-ds';`

The confirmation panel: `role="alertdialog"`. Unlike a dialog it does not close on a click outside: the user has to choose. Focus starts on Cancel.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| onOpenAutoFocus | `HeadlessContentProps['onOpenAutoFocus']` | no | - | Called when focus moves in. By default it lands on the Cancel button, the safe choice. |
| size | `DialogSize` | no | `'sm'` | Width preset: auto (fits the content), sm 24rem, md 32rem, lg 44rem, xl 56rem, full (fills the viewport less a margin). |
| container | `Element \| null` | no | - | Element to portal into. Defaults to `document.body`. |
| overlayProps | `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>` | no | - | Props for the backdrop behind the dialog. |
| forceMount | `boolean` | no | - | Keep mounted while closed, for animation libraries that manage presence themselves. |
| onCloseAutoFocus | `(event: AutoFocusEvent) => void` | no | - | Called when focus returns to the trigger on close. Prevent it to focus something else. |
| onEscapeKeyDown | `(event: DismissEvent<KeyboardEvent>) => void` | no | - | Called on Escape. Prevent it to keep the dialog open. |

Also accepts the props of `Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>, 'onPointerDownOutside' | 'onInteractOutside'>`.

```tsx
import { AlertDialog } from 'pada-ds';

<AlertDialog.Content />
```

### AlertDialog.Description

`import { AlertDialog } from 'pada-ds';`

Supporting text under the title, announced after it.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| asChild | `boolean` | no | - | Render the description's behaviour on your own element. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'p'>`.

```tsx
import { AlertDialog } from 'pada-ds';

<AlertDialog.Description />
```

### AlertDialog.Footer

`import { AlertDialog } from 'pada-ds';`

Bottom section for actions. Defaults to right-aligned buttons.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| justify | `'start' \| 'end' \| 'between'` | no | `'end'` | Main axis alignment of the section's children. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>`.

```tsx
import { AlertDialog } from 'pada-ds';

<AlertDialog.Footer />
```

### AlertDialog.Header

`import { AlertDialog } from 'pada-ds';`

Top section: the title, description and close button.

No props.

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>`.

```tsx
import { AlertDialog } from 'pada-ds';

<AlertDialog.Header />
```

### AlertDialog.Root

`import { AlertDialog } from 'pada-ds';`

Holds the open state for a dialog. Renders no element. WAI-ARIA APG: Dialog (Modal).

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `ReactNode` | no | - | - |
| open | `boolean` | no | - | Controlled open state. |
| defaultOpen | `boolean` | no | `false` | Initial open state when uncontrolled. |
| onOpenChange | `(open: boolean) => void` | no | - | Called when the dialog asks to open or close. |
| modal | `boolean` | no | `true` | Modal dialogs trap focus, lock page scroll and hide the rest of the page from assistive technology. Non-modal dialogs do none of that and close when focus leaves them. |

```tsx
import { AlertDialog } from 'pada-ds';

<AlertDialog.Root />
```

### AlertDialog.Title

`import { AlertDialog } from 'pada-ds';`

The dialog's accessible name, styled as its heading.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| asChild | `boolean` | no | - | Render the title's behaviour on your own heading element. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'h2'>`.

```tsx
import { AlertDialog } from 'pada-ds';

<AlertDialog.Title />
```

### AlertDialog.Trigger

`import { AlertDialog } from 'pada-ds';`

Opens the dialog. Gets `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` and `data-state`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| asChild | `boolean` | no | - | Merge the trigger's behaviour onto its only child instead of rendering a `<button>`. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'button'>`.

```tsx
import { AlertDialog } from 'pada-ds';

<AlertDialog.Trigger />
```

### AspectRatio

`import { AspectRatio } from 'pada-ds';`

Keeps its content at a fixed shape; images and videos inside fill it (cropped to fit).

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ratio | `number` | no | `1` | Width divided by height: `16 / 9`, `1`, `4 / 3`. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>`.

```tsx
import { AspectRatio } from 'pada-ds';

<AspectRatio />
```

### Autocomplete

`import { Autocomplete } from 'pada-ds';`

A text field with filtered suggestions (combobox): type to narrow the list, arrows to move, Enter to pick. With `multiple`, picks become chips; Backspace in the empty input removes the last.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| multiple | `false` | no | - | - |
| value | `string \| null` | no | - | - |
| defaultValue | `string \| null` | no | - | - |
| onValueChange | `(value: string \| null) => void` | no | - | - |
| label | `string` | yes | - | - |
| options | `AutocompleteOption[]` | yes | - | - |
| placeholder | `string` | no | - | - |
| description | `string` | no | - | Help text under the field. |
| error | `string` | no | - | Error message; marks the field invalid. |
| emptyMessage | `ReactNode` | no | - | Shown when nothing matches. |
| filter | `ComboboxFilter \| false` | no | - | How options match the typed text; `false` for server-side search (filter the options yourself). |
| onInputValueChange | `(value: string) => void` | no | - | Called on every keystroke, e.g. to fetch options. |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | - | - |
| required | `boolean` | no | - | - |
| name | `string` | no | - | Name for form submission (a hidden input per selected value). |
| className | `string` | no | - | - |

```tsx
import { Autocomplete } from 'pada-ds';

<Autocomplete label="..." options={[]} />
```

### Avatar

`import { Avatar } from 'pada-ds';`

A user or entity picture. Shows the image once it has loaded; until then (or if it fails) shows initials on a colour derived from the name, or a person icon when there is no name.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| src | `string` | no | - | Image URL. Falls back to initials, then a person icon, while loading or on error. |
| name | `string` | no | - | Person or entity name: the accessible name, and the source of the initials and colour. |
| alt | `string` | no | - | Alternative text for the image when it differs from `name`. |
| size | `AvatarSize` | no | `'md'` | xs 20px, sm 24px, md 32px, lg 40px, xl 56px. |
| shape | `'circle' \| 'square'` | no | `'circle'` | Circle for people, square for organisations and projects. |
| status | `AvatarStatus` | no | - | Presence dot in the corner. |

Also accepts the props of `Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'span'>, 'children'>`.

```tsx
import { Avatar } from 'pada-ds';

<Avatar />
```

### AvatarGroup

`import { AvatarGroup } from 'pada-ds';`

Overlapping avatars with a "+N" overflow counter.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| max | `number` | no | - | Show at most this many avatars, then a "+N" counter. |
| size | `AvatarSize` | no | `'md'` | Size applied to every avatar in the group. |
| label | `string` | no | - | Accessible name of the group, e.g. "Project members". |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>`.

```tsx
import { AvatarGroup } from 'pada-ds';

<AvatarGroup />
```

### Badge

`import { Badge } from 'pada-ds';`

A short status label or a count: "Beta", "Overdue", "12". For removable or clickable labels use `Tags`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tone | `BadgeTone` | no | `'neutral'` | Colour by meaning. |
| variant | `'subtle' \| 'solid' \| 'outline'` | no | `'subtle'` | `subtle` (tinted), `solid` (filled) or `outline`. |
| size | `'sm' \| 'md'` | no | `'md'` | sm for counts and dense tables, md otherwise. |
| count | `number` | no | - | A numeric count. Replaces children; bumps briefly when it changes. |
| max | `number` | no | `99` | Counts above this show as "max+". |
| dot | `boolean` | no | - | Show a leading status dot. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'span'>`.

```tsx
import { Badge } from 'pada-ds';

<Badge />
```

### Banner

`import { Banner } from 'pada-ds';`

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | `React.ReactNode` | yes | - | - |
| subtitle | `React.ReactNode` | no | - | - |
| visualIcon | `string` | no | - | Optional leading visual. Pass either: - `visualIcon` — a Material Symbols icon name (e.g. `"campaign"`), or - `visualImage` — an image URL (rendered as `<img>`). When either is set the visual is wrapped in a 12&nbsp;px-radius, stone-100 background frame per the design spec. If neither is set, the visual slot is omitted entirely so the title sits flush against the left padding. |
| visualImage | `string` | no | - | - |
| visualAlt | `string` | no | - | Alt text for `visualImage`. Ignored when `visualIcon` is used. Defaults to `""` (decorative). |
| button | `React.ReactElement<typeof Button>` | no | - | - |
| onButtonClick | `() => void` | no | - | - |
| className | `string` | no | `''` | - |

```tsx
import { Banner } from 'pada-ds';

<Banner title="..." />
```

### Breadcrumbs

`import { Breadcrumbs } from 'pada-ds';`

Where the current page sits in the hierarchy (WAI-ARIA APG Breadcrumb).

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| items | `BreadcrumbItem[]` | yes | - | Trail from the root to the current page. The last item is the current page. |
| maxItems | `number` | no | - | Collapse the middle of long trails: show the first item, an expand button, and the last `maxItems - 1` items. |
| renderLink | `(item: BreadcrumbItem, props: { className: string; children: ReactNode }) => ReactNode` | no | - | Render each link yourself (for router links). Receives the item and its default props. |
| label | `string` | no | `'Breadcrumb'` | Accessible name of the navigation landmark. |

Also accepts the props of `Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'nav'>, 'children'>`.

```tsx
import { Breadcrumbs } from 'pada-ds';

<Breadcrumbs items={[]} />
```

### Calendar

`import { Calendar } from 'pada-ds';`

A month calendar for picking a day or a range (WAI-ARIA APG date grid). Arrow keys move by day and week, Home/End to the week's ends, PageUp/PageDown by month (Shift: by year). Compose your own header with `Calendar.Root`, `Calendar.PrevButton`, `Calendar.Heading`, `Calendar.NextButton` and `Calendar.Grid`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| mode | `'single'` | no | - | Pick one day. |
| value | `Date \| null` | no | - | - |
| defaultValue | `Date \| null` | no | - | - |
| onValueChange | `(value: Date \| null) => void` | no | - | - |
| month | `Date` | no | - | Visible month (any day in it). Controlled. |
| defaultMonth | `Date` | no | - | Initially visible month when uncontrolled. Defaults to the selection, else today. |
| onMonthChange | `(month: Date) => void` | no | - | Called when the visible month changes, with its first day. |
| min | `Date` | no | - | Earliest selectable day. |
| max | `Date` | no | - | Latest selectable day. |
| isDateUnavailable | `(date: Date) => boolean` | no | - | Marks other days unavailable (weekends, holidays, booked dates). |
| weekStartsOn | `number` | no | - | First day of the week: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. |
| locale | `string` | no | - | Locale for month and day names. Defaults to the browser's. |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | - | - |
| readOnly | `boolean` | no | - | - |

Also accepts the props of `Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>, 'defaultValue' | 'onChange'>`.

```tsx
import { Calendar } from 'pada-ds';

<Calendar />
```

### Carousel

`import { Carousel } from 'pada-ds';`

A rotating set of slides (WAI-ARIA APG Carousel). Auto-rotation pauses while the pointer or keyboard focus is inside it, can be paused with its rotation button, and is off when the user prefers reduced motion.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `React.ReactNode` | yes | - | - |
| autoPlay | `boolean` | no | `true` | Advance automatically. Pauses on hover and focus, and never runs under reduced motion. |
| interval | `number` | no | `3000` | - |
| className | `string` | no | `''` | - |
| showDots | `boolean` | no | `true` | - |
| showNav | `boolean` | no | `true` | - |
| label | `string` | no | `'Carousel'` | Accessible name of the carousel region. |

```tsx
import { Carousel } from 'pada-ds';
```

### ComboBox

`import { ComboBox } from 'pada-ds';`

A list of selectable options (`role="listbox"`). Without an `id` the listbox manages focus itself: it is one tab stop, and the arrow keys, Home and End move between options. With an `id`, an owning combobox keeps focus and points at options through `aria-activedescendant` (options are `${id}-option-${index}`).

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| items | `ComboBoxItem[]` | yes | - | - |
| multiSelect | `boolean` | no | `false` | - |
| onItemClick | `(item: ComboBoxItem, index: number) => void` | no | - | - |

Also accepts the props of `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>`.

```tsx
import { ComboBox } from 'pada-ds';

<ComboBox items={[]} />
```

### CommandPalette

`import { CommandPalette } from 'pada-ds';`

A searchable list of actions in a dialog, opened with ⌘K / Ctrl+K. Type to filter (fuzzy, ranked), arrows to move, Enter to run.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| commands | `Command[]` | yes | - | - |
| open | `boolean` | no | - | Controlled open state. |
| onOpenChange | `(open: boolean) => void` | no | - | Called when the palette opens or closes. |
| placeholder | `string` | no | `'Type a command or search…'` | - |
| emptyMessage | `string` | no | `'No results'` | Shown when nothing matches. |
| hotkey | `string \| false` | no | `'k'` | Key that toggles the palette together with ⌘ (macOS) or Ctrl (elsewhere). `false` disables the shortcut. |
| label | `string` | no | `'Command palette'` | Accessible name of the dialog. |

```tsx
import { CommandPalette } from 'pada-ds';

<CommandPalette commands={[]} />
```

### ContextMenu.Content

`import { ContextMenu } from 'pada-ds';`

The menu panel, rendered in a portal and animated from its trigger.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| container | `Element \| null` | no | - | Element to portal into. Defaults to `document.body`. |
| forceMount | `boolean` | no | - | Keep mounted while closed, for animation libraries that manage presence themselves. |
| loop | `boolean` | no | - | Wrap focus from the last item to the first and back. |
| onCloseAutoFocus | `(event: AutoFocusEvent) => void` | no | - | Called when focus returns to the trigger on close. Prevent it to focus something else. |
| onEscapeKeyDown | `(event: DismissEvent<KeyboardEvent>) => void` | no | - | Called on Escape. Prevent it to keep the menu open. |
| onPointerDownOutside | `(event: DismissEvent<PointerEvent>) => void` | no | - | Called on a pointer-down outside. Prevent it to keep the menu open. |
| onInteractOutside | `(event: DismissEvent<PointerEvent \| FocusEvent>) => void` | no | - | Called on any interaction outside. Prevent it to keep the menu open. |
| side | `Side` | no | - | Preferred side of the anchor. Flips to the opposite side when there is no room. |
| align | `Align` | no | - | Alignment along the side. |
| sideOffset | `number` | no | - | Gap between anchor and content, in px. |
| alignOffset | `number` | no | - | Shift along the alignment axis, in px. |
| avoidCollisions | `boolean` | no | - | Flip and shift to stay in the viewport. |
| collisionPadding | `number` | no | - | Distance to keep from the viewport edges, in px. |
| arrowPadding | `number` | no | - | Size of the arrow element, if any, so it stays inside rounded corners. |
| hideWhenDetached | `boolean` | no | - | Hide the content when its anchor scrolls out of view. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>`.

```tsx
import { ContextMenu } from 'pada-ds';

<ContextMenu.Content />
```

### Dialog.Content

`import { Dialog } from 'pada-ds';`

The dialog panel, with its backdrop, rendered in a portal. Animates in and out; respects reduced motion. Restyle through `--pada-dialog-*` tokens on the element or a parent.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| size | `DialogSize` | no | `'md'` | Width preset: auto (fits the content), sm 24rem, md 32rem, lg 44rem, xl 56rem, full (fills the viewport less a margin). |
| container | `Element \| null` | no | - | Element to portal into. Defaults to `document.body`. |
| overlayProps | `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>` | no | - | Props for the backdrop behind the dialog. |
| forceMount | `boolean` | no | - | Keep mounted while closed, for animation libraries that manage presence themselves. |
| onOpenAutoFocus | `(event: AutoFocusEvent) => void` | no | - | Called when focus moves into the dialog on open. Prevent it to focus something else. |
| onCloseAutoFocus | `(event: AutoFocusEvent) => void` | no | - | Called when focus returns to the trigger on close. Prevent it to focus something else. |
| onEscapeKeyDown | `(event: DismissEvent<KeyboardEvent>) => void` | no | - | Called on Escape. Prevent it to keep the dialog open. |
| onPointerDownOutside | `(event: DismissEvent<PointerEvent>) => void` | no | - | Called on a pointer-down outside the content. Prevent it to keep the dialog open. |
| onInteractOutside | `(event: DismissEvent<PointerEvent \| FocusEvent>) => void` | no | - | Called on any interaction outside (pointer or focus). Prevent it to keep the dialog open. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>`.

```tsx
import { Dialog } from 'pada-ds';

<Dialog.Content />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `ReactNode` | no | - | - |
| open | `boolean` | no | - | Controlled open state. |
| defaultOpen | `boolean` | no | `false` | Initial open state when uncontrolled. |
| onOpenChange | `(open: boolean) => void` | no | - | Called when the dialog asks to open or close. |
| modal | `boolean` | no | `true` | Modal dialogs trap focus, lock page scroll and hide the rest of the page from assistive technology. Non-modal dialogs do none of that and close when focus leaves them. |

```tsx
import { Dialog } from 'pada-ds';

<Dialog.Root />
```

### Drawer.Content

`import { Drawer } from 'pada-ds';`

A dialog panel that slides in from an edge of the screen, with its backdrop, rendered in a portal. Use the Dialog parts inside it (`Drawer.Header`, `Drawer.Title`, `Drawer.Body`, …).

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| side | `DrawerSide` | no | `'right'` | Edge the drawer slides in from. |
| size | `DrawerSize` | no | `'sm'` | Width (left/right) or height (top/bottom): sm 496px, md 640px, lg 800px, xl 960px. |
| container | `Element \| null` | no | - | Element to portal into. Defaults to `document.body`. |
| overlayProps | `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>` | no | - | Props for the backdrop behind the drawer. |
| forceMount | `boolean` | no | - | Keep mounted while closed, for animation libraries that manage presence themselves. |
| onOpenAutoFocus | `(event: AutoFocusEvent) => void` | no | - | Called when focus moves into the dialog on open. Prevent it to focus something else. |
| onCloseAutoFocus | `(event: AutoFocusEvent) => void` | no | - | Called when focus returns to the trigger on close. Prevent it to focus something else. |
| onEscapeKeyDown | `(event: DismissEvent<KeyboardEvent>) => void` | no | - | Called on Escape. Prevent it to keep the dialog open. |
| onPointerDownOutside | `(event: DismissEvent<PointerEvent>) => void` | no | - | Called on a pointer-down outside the content. Prevent it to keep the dialog open. |
| onInteractOutside | `(event: DismissEvent<PointerEvent \| FocusEvent>) => void` | no | - | Called on any interaction outside (pointer or focus). Prevent it to keep the dialog open. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>`.

```tsx
import { Drawer } from 'pada-ds';

<Drawer.Content />
```

### DropdownMenu.Content

`import { DropdownMenu } from 'pada-ds';`

The menu panel, rendered in a portal and animated from its trigger.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| container | `Element \| null` | no | - | Element to portal into. Defaults to `document.body`. |
| forceMount | `boolean` | no | - | Keep mounted while closed, for animation libraries that manage presence themselves. |
| loop | `boolean` | no | - | Wrap focus from the last item to the first and back. |
| onCloseAutoFocus | `(event: AutoFocusEvent) => void` | no | - | Called when focus returns to the trigger on close. Prevent it to focus something else. |
| onEscapeKeyDown | `(event: DismissEvent<KeyboardEvent>) => void` | no | - | Called on Escape. Prevent it to keep the menu open. |
| onPointerDownOutside | `(event: DismissEvent<PointerEvent>) => void` | no | - | Called on a pointer-down outside. Prevent it to keep the menu open. |
| onInteractOutside | `(event: DismissEvent<PointerEvent \| FocusEvent>) => void` | no | - | Called on any interaction outside. Prevent it to keep the menu open. |
| side | `Side` | no | - | Preferred side of the anchor. Flips to the opposite side when there is no room. |
| align | `Align` | no | - | Alignment along the side. |
| sideOffset | `number` | no | - | Gap between anchor and content, in px. |
| alignOffset | `number` | no | - | Shift along the alignment axis, in px. |
| avoidCollisions | `boolean` | no | - | Flip and shift to stay in the viewport. |
| collisionPadding | `number` | no | - | Distance to keep from the viewport edges, in px. |
| arrowPadding | `number` | no | - | Size of the arrow element, if any, so it stays inside rounded corners. |
| hideWhenDetached | `boolean` | no | - | Hide the content when its anchor scrolls out of view. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>`.

```tsx
import { DropdownMenu } from 'pada-ds';

<DropdownMenu.Content />
```

### Filter

`import { Filter } from 'pada-ds';`

Filter — a toolbar chip backed by a popover-driven ComboBox. Single-select: clicking an option commits immediately and closes the popover. Multi-select : the popover stages selections in a local draft, then commits on Apply (or discards on Escape or an outside click). The chip shows a count badge whenever there is at least one selection. In the popover the arrow keys move between options and Escape closes it, returning focus to the chip.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | `string` | yes | - | Label shown on the chip (e.g. "Status"). |
| options | `FilterOption[]` | yes | - | Options the user can pick from. |
| multiSelect | `boolean` | no | `false` | When true, the popover shows ticks for every option and keeps itself open until the user clicks Apply / Clear. When false, picking an option fires `onChange` and closes the popover immediately. |
| value | `string[]` | no | - | Controlled selection. Always an array — use `[value]` for single-select. |
| defaultValue | `string[]` | no | `[]` | Uncontrolled initial selection. |
| onChange | `(values: string[], options: FilterOption[]) => void` | no | - | Fired whenever the selection commits: - single-select: on every click - multi-select: on Apply / Clear only Receives the new array of selected values plus the matching `FilterOption[]`. |
| applyLabel | `string` | no | `'Apply'` | Override the Apply button label. Defaults to "Apply". |
| clearLabel | `string` | no | `'Clear'` | Override the Clear button label. Defaults to "Clear". |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | `false` | - |
| className | `string` | no | `''` | - |

```tsx
import { Filter } from 'pada-ds';

<Filter label="..." options={[]} />
```

### FilterChip

`import { FilterChip } from 'pada-ds';`

A filter shown as a chip: its main button edits the filter, the cross removes it.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variant | `FilterChipVariant` | no | `'filled'` | - |
| label | `string` | no | `'Field'` | - |
| value | `string` | no | `'Attribute'` | - |
| showClose | `boolean` | no | `true` | - |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | `false` | - |

| onClick | `() => void` | no | - | - |
| className | `string` | no | `''` | - |

```tsx
import { FilterChip } from 'pada-ds';

<FilterChip />
```

### Grid

`import { Grid } from 'pada-ds';`

CSS grid layout with token gaps: fixed columns, or as many as fit (`minItemWidth`).

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| columns | `number` | no | `1` | Fixed number of equal columns. Ignored when `minItemWidth` is set. |
| minItemWidth | `string` | no | - | Fit as many columns as there is room for, each at least this wide (`240px`, `16rem`). Responsive without breakpoints. |
| gap | `Space` | no | `4` | Gap in spacing steps, like Stack: `gap={4}` is 16px at default density. |
| rowGap | `Space` | no | - | Row gap, when it differs from `gap`. |
| align | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end' \| 'stretch'` | no | - | Cross-axis alignment of items. |
| as | `ElementType` | no | `'div'` | Element to render, e.g. `ul` or `section`. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>`.

```tsx
import { Grid } from 'pada-ds';

<Grid />
```

### HeaderCell

`import { HeaderCell } from 'pada-ds';`

A column header (`role="columnheader"`). Drag it onto another header to reorder columns; drag its right edge, or focus the edge and press Left/Right, to resize. With `onSort`, the label is a button and the header reports `aria-sort`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| columnId | `string` | yes | - | - |
| label | `string` | yes | - | - |
| className | `string` | no | `''` | - |
| sortDirection | `SortDirection` | no | - | Current sort of this column. Set it (with `onSort`) to make the header a sort button. |
| onSort | `() => void` | no | - | Called when the header is activated; flip `sortDirection` in response. |

```tsx
import { HeaderCell } from 'pada-ds';

<HeaderCell columnId="..." label="..." />
```

### HoverCard

`import { HoverCard } from 'pada-ds';`

A rich preview shown when people hover or focus a link: a profile, a page, a repository. Opens after a short delay and stays open while the pointer is over the card. The card is supplementary: what it shows must also be reachable through the link itself. Compose `HoverCard.Root`, `HoverCard.Trigger`, `HoverCard.Content` and `HoverCard.Arrow` for full control.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `ReactElement` | yes | - | The trigger: a link or a name. It receives the hover and focus handlers. |
| content | `ReactNode` | yes | - | The card's content. |
| side | `HeadlessContentProps['side']` | no | - | - |
| align | `HeadlessContentProps['align']` | no | - | - |
| arrow | `boolean` | no | - | Show an arrow pointing at the trigger. |
| className | `string` | no | - | - |
| open | `boolean` | no | - | - |
| defaultOpen | `boolean` | no | - | - |
| onOpenChange | `(open: boolean) => void` | no | - | - |
| openDelay | `number` | no | - | Hover (or focus) time before the card opens, in ms. |
| closeDelay | `number` | no | - | Time after the pointer leaves before the card closes, in ms. |

```tsx
import { HoverCard } from 'pada-ds';

<HoverCard content="..."><span>...</span></HoverCard>
```

### HoverCard.Arrow

`import { HoverCard } from 'pada-ds';`

Arrow pointing at the trigger.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| asChild | `boolean` | no | - | - |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'span'>`.

```tsx

```

### HoverCard.Content

`import { HoverCard } from 'pada-ds';`

The card, in a portal, animated from the side that faces the trigger.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| container | `Element \| null` | no | - | Element to portal into. Defaults to the nearest portal container, else `document.body`. |
| forceMount | `boolean` | no | - | - |
| onEscapeKeyDown | `(event: DismissEvent<KeyboardEvent>) => void` | no | - | Called on Escape. Prevent it to keep the card open. |
| side | `Side` | no | - | Preferred side of the anchor. Flips to the opposite side when there is no room. |
| align | `Align` | no | - | Alignment along the side. |
| sideOffset | `number` | no | - | Gap between anchor and content, in px. |
| alignOffset | `number` | no | - | Shift along the alignment axis, in px. |
| avoidCollisions | `boolean` | no | - | Flip and shift to stay in the viewport. |
| collisionPadding | `number` | no | - | Distance to keep from the viewport edges, in px. |
| arrowPadding | `number` | no | - | Size of the arrow element, if any, so it stays inside rounded corners. |
| hideWhenDetached | `boolean` | no | - | Hide the content when its anchor scrolls out of view. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>`.

```tsx
import { HoverCard } from 'pada-ds';

<HoverCard.Content />
```

### HoverCard.Root

`import { HoverCard } from 'pada-ds';`

A preview card for a link or name, shown on hover and keyboard focus. Renders no element. The card is supplementary: everything in it must also be reachable through the trigger (the profile the link goes to), since touch and screen-reader users may never see it.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `ReactNode` | no | - | - |
| open | `boolean` | no | - | - |
| defaultOpen | `boolean` | no | `false` | - |
| onOpenChange | `(open: boolean) => void` | no | - | - |
| openDelay | `number` | no | `700` | Hover (or focus) time before the card opens, in ms. |
| closeDelay | `number` | no | `300` | Time after the pointer leaves before the card closes, in ms. |

```tsx
import { HoverCard } from 'pada-ds';

<HoverCard.Root />
```

### HoverCard.Trigger

`import { HoverCard } from 'pada-ds';`

The link the card previews. Opens the card on hover (not touch) and on keyboard focus.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| asChild | `boolean` | no | - | Merge the behaviour onto your own element (a router link, a name). |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'a'>`.

```tsx

<HoverCard.Trigger />
```

### Icon

`import { Icon } from 'pada-ds';`

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name | `string` | no | - | Icon name (snake_case). Built-in names (see the exported `iconNames`, e.g. `tick_1`, `chevron_down`, `cross_1`, `search`) are bundled with the library and render synchronously — no network request, and they work during SSR. Any other name falls back to Material Symbols, fetched from a CDN (browse https://fonts.google.com/icons, set "Material Symbols"). If the name doesn't resolve in either place, nothing is rendered. |
| src | `string` | no | - | Custom SVG source URL or raw SVG markup. Takes precedence over `name` when set. |
| size | `number \| string` | no | `20` | Pixel size of the icon. Defaults to 20. |
| color | `string` | no | `'currentColor'` | Color override. Defaults to `currentColor` so the icon inherits text color. |
| variant | `IconVariant` | no | `'stroke'` | Only applies to the Material Symbols fallback, which ships several styles. The two we expose: - `'stroke'` (default): the **outlined** style — lines / outlines. - `'fill'`: the **filled** style — solid silhouettes. The two are mutually exclusive at the asset level (we fetch a different file each way), so an icon can never accidentally show both at once. Built-in icons have one style. |

Also accepts the props of `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>`.

```tsx
import { Icon } from 'pada-ds';

<Icon />
```

### IconButton

`import { IconButton } from 'pada-ds';`

A square button with only an icon. Defaults to the ghost variant.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| icon | `string` | yes | - | Built-in icon name. |
| label | `string` | yes | - | Accessible name. Required: an icon alone has no text for screen readers. |
| tooltip | `boolean` | no | `false` | Also show the label in a tooltip on hover and focus. |
| variant | `ButtonVariant` | no | `'ghost'` | - |
| size | `ButtonSize` | no | `'md'` | Height and padding: sm 28px, md 32px, lg 40px (scaled by density). |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | - | - |
| loading | `boolean` | no | - | Shows a spinner in place of the label and ignores clicks, keeping the button's width and focus. Announced through `aria-busy`. |
| ref | `React.Ref<HTMLButtonElement>` | no | - | - |

Also accepts the props of `Omit<React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'children' | 'leftIcon' | 'rightIcon' | 'split' | 'onSplitClick' | 'aria-label'>`.

```tsx
import { IconButton } from 'pada-ds';

<IconButton icon="..." label="..." />
```

### InputDate

| selection | `DatePickerSelection` | no | `'single'` | - |
| value | `Date \| [Date, Date?] \| null` | no | - | - |
| onChange | `(value: Date \| [Date, Date?] \| null) => void` | no | - | - |
| minDate | `Date` | no | - | - |
| maxDate | `Date` | no | - | - |
| isDateUnavailable | `(date: Date) => boolean` | no | - | Marks other days unavailable (weekends, holidays, booked dates). |

### MoreFilter

`import { MoreFilter } from 'pada-ds';`

MoreFilter — a single chip that opens a tandem ComboBox popover: left column = list of filter names right column = options for the focused filter footer = Apply / Clear Useful when the toolbar can't fit every filter as a standalone chip. The filter names are a vertical tab list (Up/Down move between them), each showing its options as a listbox.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | `string` | no | `'More'` | Chip label. Defaults to "More". |
| filters | `MoreFilterDescriptor[]` | yes | - | Descriptors for every filter that lives behind the More popover. |
| value | `MoreFilterValues` | no | - | Controlled value: a map of `filterId → selectedValues[]`. |
| defaultValue | `MoreFilterValues` | no | `{}` | Uncontrolled initial value. |
| onChange | `(values: MoreFilterValues, count: number) => void` | no | - | Fires when the user clicks Apply. Receives the full values map plus a convenience `count` aggregate so consumers don't have to recompute it. |
| applyLabel | `string` | no | `'Apply'` | - |
| clearLabel | `string` | no | `'Clear all'` | - |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | `false` | - |
| className | `string` | no | `''` | - |

```tsx
import { MoreFilter } from 'pada-ds';

<MoreFilter filters={[]} />
```

### NumberInput

`import { NumberInput } from 'pada-ds';`

A number field (WAI-ARIA APG Spinbutton): type a value, or use Up/Down, PageUp/PageDown and Home/End, or the steppers (hold to repeat). Values are formatted with `formatOptions` (currency, percent, units) and typed text is parsed in the same locale.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | `string` | yes | - | - |
| description | `string` | no | - | Help text under the field. |
| error | `string` | no | - | Error message; marks the field invalid. |
| required | `boolean` | no | - | - |
| optional | `boolean` | no | - | Show "(optional)" after the label. |
| placeholder | `string` | no | - | - |
| stepper | `'stacked' \| 'split' \| 'none'` | no | `'stacked'` | `stacked`: up/down arrows at the end; `split`: minus at the start and plus at the end; `none`. |
| size | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | no | `'md'` | Control height. |
| value | `number \| null` | no | - | Controlled value; `null` when empty. |
| defaultValue | `number \| null` | no | - | Initial value when uncontrolled. |
| onValueChange | `(value: number \| null) => void` | no | - | Called with the committed value (on step, Enter or blur), `null` when cleared. |
| min | `number` | no | - | - |
| max | `number` | no | - | - |
| step | `number` | no | - | Arrow keys and the steppers change the value by this much. |
| largeStep | `number` | no | - | PageUp and PageDown change the value by this much. |
| formatOptions | `Intl.NumberFormatOptions` | no | - | Display format: currency, percent, units, fraction digits. |
| locale | `string` | no | - | Locale for formatting and parsing. Defaults to the browser's. |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | - | - |
| readOnly | `boolean` | no | - | - |
| name | `string` | no | - | Submits the raw number (not the formatted text) with forms under this name. |

Also accepts the props of `Omit<Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>, 'defaultValue' | 'onChange'>, 'children' | 'inputId'>`.

```tsx
import { NumberInput } from 'pada-ds';

<NumberInput label="..." />
```

### PadaLogo

| size | `keyof typeof SIZES \| number` | no | `'md'` | Height in px, or a preset. |
| toes | `boolean` | no | - | Draw a toe above each sole. Defaults to on from 48px up, where it stays legible. |
| animated | `boolean \| 'loop'` | no | `false` | `true` steps in once on mount (left sole, right sole, then the ground); `'loop'` walks, for a branded loading indicator. Both are still under reduced motion. |
| title | `string` | no | - | Accessible name. |
| decorative | `boolean` | no | `false` | Hide from assistive technology when a text label sits next to it. |

Also accepts the props of `Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'svg'>, 'children'>`.


### PinInput

`import { PinInput } from 'pada-ds';`

A code or PIN field with one box per character. Typing moves to the next box, Backspace goes back, and pasting (or a phone autofilling a code from a text message) fills every box.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | `string` | yes | - | - |
| description | `string` | no | - | - |
| error | `string` | no | - | - |
| groupSize | `number` | no | - | Put a separator after every `groupSize` boxes (3 makes "123–456"). |
| size | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | no | `'md'` | - |
| length | `number` | yes | - | Number of characters. |
| value | `string` | no | - | Controlled value (may be shorter than `length` while typing). |
| defaultValue | `string` | no | - | - |
| onValueChange | `(value: string) => void` | no | - | Called with the characters so far; a blank box between filled ones is a space. |
| onComplete | `(value: string) => void` | no | - | Called once every box is filled. |
| type | `'numeric' \| 'alphanumeric'` | no | - | Accepted characters. |
| mask | `boolean` | no | - | Hide the characters, like a password. |
| otp | `boolean` | no | - | One-time code: lets browsers and phones autofill it from a text message. |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | - | - |
| placeholder | `string` | no | - | Placeholder in each empty box. |
| name | `string` | no | - | Submits the joined value with forms under this name. |

Also accepts the props of `Omit<Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>, 'defaultValue' | 'onChange'>, 'children'>`.

```tsx
import { PinInput } from 'pada-ds';

<PinInput label="..." length={0} />
```

### Popover

`import { Popover } from 'pada-ds';`

A panel anchored to a trigger. Closes on Escape, on a click outside and when focus leaves it. Also a namespace of compound parts for full control: `Popover.Root`, `Popover.Trigger`, `Popover.Anchor`, `Popover.Content`, `Popover.Title`, `Popover.Arrow`, `Popover.Close`, `Popover.CloseButton`. ```tsx <Popover.Root> <Popover.Trigger asChild><Button variant="secondary">Filters</Button></Popover.Trigger> <Popover.Content side="bottom" align="start"> <Popover.Title>Filters</Popover.Title> … <Popover.CloseButton /> </Popover.Content> </Popover.Root> ```

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| open | `boolean` | yes | - | - |
| onOpenChange | `(open: boolean) => void` | yes | - | - |
| children | `React.ReactNode` | yes | - | - |
| trigger | `React.ReactElement` | no | - | Element that toggles the popover. It receives the trigger's ARIA attributes. |
| position | `PopoverPosition` | no | `'auto'` | Preferred side. `auto` prefers the bottom; every side flips when there is no room. |
| title | `string` | no | - | - |
| variant | `PopoverVariant` | no | `'default'` | - |
| showClose | `boolean` | no | `true` | - |
| className | `string` | no | - | - |
| clickPosition | `{ x: number; y: number }` | no | - | Viewport coordinates to anchor the popover at instead of the trigger (a context menu, say). |

```tsx
import { Popover } from 'pada-ds';

<Popover open={true} onOpenChange={() => {}}>...</Popover>
```

### Popover.Anchor

`import { Popover } from 'pada-ds';`

Positions the content against this element instead of the trigger.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| asChild | `boolean` | no | - | Use your own element as the anchor instead of rendering a `<div>`. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>`.

```tsx
import { Popover } from 'pada-ds';

<Popover.Anchor />
```

### Popover.Arrow

`import { Popover } from 'pada-ds';`

Arrow pointing at the trigger.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| asChild | `boolean` | no | - | Render your own arrow element (an SVG, usually). |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'span'>`.

```tsx
import { Popover } from 'pada-ds';

<Popover.Arrow />
```

### Popover.Close

`import { Popover } from 'pada-ds';`

Closes the popover. Give icon-only close buttons an `aria-label`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| asChild | `boolean` | no | - | Merge the close behaviour onto its only child instead of rendering a `<button>`. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'button'>`.

```tsx
import { Popover } from 'pada-ds';

<Popover.Close />
```

### Popover.CloseButton

`import { Popover } from 'pada-ds';`

Icon button in the top corner that closes the popover.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | `string` | no | `'Close'` | Accessible name of the icon button. |

Also accepts the props of `Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'button'>, 'children' | 'asChild'>`.

```tsx
import { Popover } from 'pada-ds';

<Popover.CloseButton />
```

### Popover.Content

`import { Popover } from 'pada-ds';`

The floating panel, rendered in a portal and animated from the side that faces its trigger.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variant | `PopoverContentVariant` | no | `'default'` | Surface style: default (solid border), dashed, or active (accent border with a glow). |
| container | `Element \| null` | no | - | Element to portal into. Defaults to `document.body`. |
| forceMount | `boolean` | no | - | Keep mounted while closed, for animation libraries that manage presence themselves. |
| onOpenAutoFocus | `(event: AutoFocusEvent) => void` | no | - | Called when focus moves into the popover on open. Prevent it to keep focus where it is. |
| onCloseAutoFocus | `(event: AutoFocusEvent) => void` | no | - | Called when focus returns to the trigger on close. Prevent it to focus something else. |
| onEscapeKeyDown | `(event: DismissEvent<KeyboardEvent>) => void` | no | - | Called on Escape. Prevent it to keep the popover open. |
| onPointerDownOutside | `(event: DismissEvent<PointerEvent>) => void` | no | - | Called on a pointer-down outside. Prevent it to keep the popover open. |
| onFocusOutside | `(event: DismissEvent<FocusEvent>) => void` | no | - | Called when focus moves outside. Prevent it to keep the popover open. |
| onInteractOutside | `(event: DismissEvent<PointerEvent \| FocusEvent>) => void` | no | - | Called on any interaction outside. Prevent it to keep the popover open. |
| side | `Side` | no | - | Preferred side of the anchor. Flips to the opposite side when there is no room. |
| align | `Align` | no | - | Alignment along the side. |
| sideOffset | `number` | no | `8` | Gap between anchor and content, in px. |
| alignOffset | `number` | no | - | Shift along the alignment axis, in px. |
| avoidCollisions | `boolean` | no | - | Flip and shift to stay in the viewport. |
| collisionPadding | `number` | no | - | Distance to keep from the viewport edges, in px. |
| arrowPadding | `number` | no | - | Size of the arrow element, if any, so it stays inside rounded corners. |
| hideWhenDetached | `boolean` | no | - | Hide the content when its anchor scrolls out of view. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>`.

```tsx
import { Popover } from 'pada-ds';

<Popover.Content />
```

### Popover.Root

`import { Popover } from 'pada-ds';`

Holds the open state for a popover. Renders no element.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `ReactNode` | no | - | - |
| open | `boolean` | no | - | Controlled open state. |
| defaultOpen | `boolean` | no | `false` | Initial open state when uncontrolled. |
| onOpenChange | `(open: boolean) => void` | no | - | Called when the popover asks to open or close. |
| modal | `boolean` | no | `false` | Modal popovers trap focus and hide the rest of the page from assistive technology. |

```tsx
import { Popover } from 'pada-ds';

<Popover.Root />
```

### Popover.Title

`import { Popover } from 'pada-ds';`

The popover's heading; names the popover for assistive technology.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| asChild | `boolean` | no | - | Render the title's behaviour on your own heading element. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'h2'>`.


### RadioCardGroup

`import { RadioCardGroup } from 'pada-ds';`

A single choice presented as cards with a title, description, icon and extra content (plans, shipping speeds, templates). Built on native radio inputs: Tab reaches the group, arrow keys move and select, and the value submits with forms.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | `ReactNode` | yes | - | - |
| options | `RadioCardOption[]` | yes | - | - |
| value | `string` | no | - | - |
| defaultValue | `string` | no | - | - |
| onValueChange | `(value: string) => void` | no | - | - |
| description | `ReactNode` | no | - | Help text under the label. |
| name | `string` | no | - | Name for form submission. Generated when omitted. |
| columns | `number` | no | `3` | Cards per row (they wrap to fewer on narrow screens). |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | `false` | - |
| required | `boolean` | no | - | - |
| className | `string` | no | - | - |

```tsx
import { RadioCardGroup } from 'pada-ds';

<RadioCardGroup label="..." options={[]} />
```

### RangeSlider

`import { RangeSlider } from 'pada-ds';`

A slider with two thumbs for picking a range (price, dates, size). Each thumb is a slider in its own right: arrow keys step, PageUp/PageDown take ten steps, Home/End jump as far as the other thumb allows. Pressing the track moves the nearest thumb.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | `string` | yes | - | - |
| value | `[number, number]` | no | - | Controlled `[low, high]`. |
| defaultValue | `[number, number]` | no | - | Initial `[low, high]` when uncontrolled. |
| onValueChange | `(value: [number, number]) => void` | no | - | Called on every change while dragging or pressing keys. |
| onValueCommit | `(value: [number, number]) => void` | no | - | Called when a drag ends or a key press changes the value. |
| min | `number` | no | `0` | - |
| max | `number` | no | `100` | - |
| step | `number` | no | `1` | - |
| minStepsBetweenThumbs | `number` | no | `0` | Steps kept between the two thumbs. |
| formatOptions | `Intl.NumberFormatOptions` | no | - | Number format for the values shown and announced. |
| locale | `string` | no | - | - |
| showValue | `boolean` | no | `true` | Show the selected range next to the label. |
| thumbLabels | `[string, string]` | no | - | Accessible names of the thumbs. |
| description | `string` | no | - | - |
| error | `string` | no | - | - |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | `false` | - |
| name | `string` | no | - | Submits both values with forms under this name. |
| className | `string` | no | - | - |

```tsx
import { RangeSlider } from 'pada-ds';

<RangeSlider label="..." />
```

### Rating

`import { Rating } from 'pada-ds';`

A star rating. Interactive ratings are a radio group (Tab in, arrow keys to change, and the value submits with forms); hovering previews. Read-only ratings are a single image named "4.5 out of 5 stars".

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | `string` | yes | - | - |
| value | `number` | no | - | - |
| defaultValue | `number` | no | `0` | - |
| onValueChange | `(value: number) => void` | no | - | - |
| max | `number` | no | `5` | - |
| readOnly | `boolean` | no | `false` | Show the rating without letting people change it; fractions (3.5) are drawn partly filled. |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | `false` | - |
| allowClear | `boolean` | no | `true` | Clicking the current rating again clears it. |
| showLabel | `boolean` | no | `true` | Visible label beside the stars, or hide it (it still names the control). |
| size | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | no | `'md'` | - |
| name | `string` | no | - | Name for form submission. |
| className | `string` | no | - | - |

```tsx
import { Rating } from 'pada-ds';

<Rating label="..." />
```

### ScrollArea

`import { ScrollArea } from 'pada-ds';`

A scrolling region with slim, themed scrollbars and faded edges. Scrolling stays native (touch, wheel, keyboard, scroll snapping, find-in-page). When content overflows, the region becomes focusable so keyboard users can scroll it; give it an `aria-label` then.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| orientation | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal' \| 'both'` | no | `'vertical'` | Which way it scrolls. |
| maxHeight | `number \| string` | no | - | Maximum height (vertical) before it scrolls, e.g. 320 or "50vh". |
| maxWidth | `number \| string` | no | - | Maximum width (horizontal) before it scrolls. |
| fade | `boolean` | no | `true` | Fade the edges where more content is hidden. |
| scrollbar | `'auto' \| 'always'` | no | `'auto'` | `auto` shows the thin scrollbar while hovering or scrolling; `always` keeps it. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>`.

```tsx
import { ScrollArea } from 'pada-ds';

<ScrollArea />
```

### SegmentControl

`import { SegmentControl } from 'pada-ds';`

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| options | `SegmentOption[]` | yes | - | - |
| value | `string` | no | - | - |
| defaultValue | `string` | no | - | - |
| onChange | `(value: string, option: SegmentOption) => void` | no | - | Fired whenever the active segment changes (via click or keyboard). The callback receives the newly active option's `value` as well as the full `SegmentOption` so consumers can read label/icon/etc. without an extra lookup. When operating in controlled mode (`value` prop supplied), the consumer MUST update the `value` from this callback for the visible active segment to shift. |
| className | `string` | no | `''` | - |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | `false` | - |

```tsx
import { SegmentControl } from 'pada-ds';
```

### Select

`import { Select } from 'pada-ds';`

A select-only combobox (WAI-ARIA APG): focus stays on the trigger while the arrow keys, Home/End and type-ahead move through the options. The list renders in a portal, flips above the trigger when there is no room below, and matches the trigger's width.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | `string` | yes | - | - |
| options | `SelectOption[]` | yes | - | - |
| value | `string \| number` | no | - | Controlled value. When provided, the parent owns selection state and MUST update it from `onChange` for the trigger to reflect the click. |
| defaultValue | `string \| number` | no | - | Uncontrolled initial value. Ignored when `value` is provided. |
| placeholder | `string` | no | `'Select an option'` | Placeholder shown when no value is selected. |
| onChange | `(value: string \| number, option: SelectOption) => void` | no | - | Fired after the user picks an option from the dropdown. Receives the newly selected `value` plus the full `SelectOption` (label / disabled / etc.) so consumers don't have to look it up. |
| description | `string` | no | - | - |
| error | `string` | no | - | - |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | `false` | - |
| name | `string` | no | - | - |
| id | `string` | no | - | - |
| className | `string` | no | - | - |

```tsx
import { Select } from 'pada-ds';

<Select label="..." options={[]} />
```

### SideDrawer

`import { SideDrawer } from 'pada-ds';`


### Stack

`import { Stack } from 'pada-ds';`

Flex layout with token-based gaps, so spacing follows density.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| direction | `'row' \| 'column'` | no | `'column'` | Main axis. |
| gap | `Space` | no | `2` | Gap in spacing steps (n × 0.25rem × density): `gap={3}` is 12px at default density. |
| align | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end' \| 'stretch' \| 'baseline'` | no | - | Cross-axis alignment. |
| justify | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end' \| 'between' \| 'around'` | no | - | Main-axis distribution. |
| wrap | `boolean` | no | - | Wrap onto new lines when out of room. |
| as | `ElementType` | no | `'div'` | Element to render, e.g. `ul`, `section`, `nav`. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>`.

```tsx
import { Stack } from 'pada-ds';

<Stack />
```

### Stat

`import { Stat } from 'pada-ds';`

A key figure (KPI): a label, a big value that counts to its new number when it changes, an optional delta coloured by whether the change is good, a description and a chart slot.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | `ReactNode` | yes | - | - |
| value | `number \| ReactNode` | yes | - | A number (formatted and animated) or any content. |
| formatOptions | `Intl.NumberFormatOptions` | no | - | Number format for `value`: currency, percent, compact notation, units. |
| locale | `string` | no | - | - |
| delta | `number` | no | - | Change since the comparison period, e.g. 0.125 with a percent format, or 12. |
| deltaFormatOptions | `Intl.NumberFormatOptions` | no | - | Number format for `delta`. Defaults to `formatOptions` with a sign. |
| deltaLabel | `ReactNode` | no | - | Comparison text after the delta, e.g. "vs last week". |
| trend | `StatTrend` | no | - | Direction of the delta. Defaults to the delta's sign. |
| invertTrend | `boolean` | no | `false` | When going down is good (costs, errors, latency): down shows as positive. |
| description | `ReactNode` | no | - | Help text under the value. |
| chart | `ReactNode` | no | - | Slot for a sparkline or small chart. |
| animate | `boolean` | no | `true` | Count up from the previous value when it changes. |
| size | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | no | `'md'` | - |
| className | `string` | no | - | - |

```tsx
import { Stat } from 'pada-ds';

<Stat label="..." value="..." />
```

### Tabs

`import { Tabs } from 'pada-ds';`

Tabbed sections (WAI-ARIA APG Tabs): arrow keys move between tabs, Home/End jump to the ends. Pass `<TabPanel label="…">` children for the simple API, or compose the parts: `Tabs.Root` (string values, `variant`, `orientation`, `activationMode`), `Tabs.List`, `Tabs.Trigger`, `Tabs.Content`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |

| value | `number` | no | - | Controlled active index. |
| onChange | `(index: number) => void` | no | - | Fires whenever the active tab changes. |

```tsx
import { Tabs } from 'pada-ds';
```

### TagInput

`import { TagInput } from 'pada-ds';`

Free-form tags (emails, keywords, labels) typed into one field. Enter or a comma adds the text as a tag; pasting a comma- or line-separated list adds them all. Backspace in the empty field moves to the tags, where Backspace or Delete removes one and the arrow keys move between them. For picking from known options, use Autocomplete with `multiple`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | `string` | yes | - | - |
| value | `string[]` | no | - | Controlled tags. |
| defaultValue | `string[]` | no | `[]` | Initial tags when uncontrolled. |
| onValueChange | `(value: string[]) => void` | no | - | - |
| placeholder | `string` | no | - | - |
| description | `string` | no | - | - |
| error | `string` | no | - | - |
| separators | `string[]` | no | `['Enter', ',']` | Keys that turn the typed text into a tag. |
| maxTags | `number` | no | - | Maximum number of tags. |
| allowDuplicates | `boolean` | no | `false` | Allow the same tag twice. |
| validate | `(tag: string) => string \| null \| undefined` | no | - | Return an error message to reject a tag. |
| addOnBlur | `boolean` | no | `true` | Turn left-over text into a tag when the field loses focus. |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | `false` | - |
| required | `boolean` | no | - | - |
| name | `string` | no | - | Submits each tag with forms under this name. |
| className | `string` | no | - | - |

```tsx
import { TagInput } from 'pada-ds';

<TagInput label="..." />
```

### ThemeProvider

`import { ThemeProvider } from 'pada-ds';`

Sets Pada's theme axes (`data-theme`, `data-accent`, `data-density`, …) for the page or a subtree, and shares them through `useTheme()`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `ReactNode` | no | - | - |
| defaultTheme | `ThemeMode` | no | `'system'` | Initial theme when uncontrolled (and nothing is stored). |
| onThemeChange | `(theme: ThemeMode) => void` | no | - | Called when `setTheme` changes the theme. |
| target | `'root' \| 'element'` | no | `'element'` | `root` applies the attributes to `<html>` (the whole page); `element` wraps the children in a `display: contents` element, so a section can have its own theme. |
| storageKey | `string` | no | - | Remember the chosen theme in localStorage under this key. |
| theme | `ThemeMode` | no | - | Light, dark, or follow the operating system. |
| accent | `string` | no | - | Accent palette: any palette hue (`indigo`, `amber`, `emerald`, …) or `custom` (uses `--pada-accent-hue`). |
| neutral | `'stone' \| 'slate' \| 'gray' \| 'zinc' \| 'neutral'` | no | - | Neutral palette for surfaces, text and borders. |
| density | `'compact' \| 'comfortable' \| 'spacious'` | no | - | - |
| radius | `'none' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | no | - | - |
| motion | `'reduced' \| 'full'` | no | - | Override the OS reduced-motion setting. |
| contrast | `'standard' \| 'more'` | no | - | - |

```tsx
import { ThemeProvider } from 'pada-ds';

<ThemeProvider />
```

### Timeline

An ordered list of events (activity feeds, audit logs, order tracking) joined by a line. Events appear one after another on mount; pending events are drawn hollow and dashed.

| children | `ReactNode` | no | - | `Timeline.Item`s, instead of `items`. |
| density | `'compact' \| 'comfortable'` | no | `'comfortable'` | Gap between events. |

Also accepts the props of `Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'ol'>, 'children'>`.

```tsx
import { Timeline } from 'pada-ds';

<Timeline />
```

### Toaster

`import { Toaster } from 'pada-ds';`

Renders toasts created with `toast()`. Toasts stack in a corner and expand on hover or focus; timers pause while the stack is hovered or focused, or the window is in the background. Swipe a toast sideways or press Escape on it to dismiss it. F8 jumps to the toasts.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| position | `ToasterPosition` | no | `'bottom-right'` | Corner (or edge) where toasts appear. |
| visibleToasts | `number` | no | `3` | How many toasts show at once; older ones wait in the stack. |
| label | `string` | no | `'Notifications'` | Accessible name of the region. The hotkey is appended: "Notifications (F8)". |
| hotkey | `string` | no | `'F8'` | Key that moves focus to the toasts. |
| className | `string` | no | - | - |

```tsx
import { Toaster } from 'pada-ds';

<Toaster />
```
