### Toolbar

`import { Toolbar } from 'pada-ds';`

Toolbar — Figma node 22:947. Two-slot layout: a left cluster of filters / view-switcher, a right cluster built from typed Button descriptors. The right cluster always renders design-system `<Button>` components — consumers can't slip in custom button markup.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| left | `React.ReactNode` | no | - | Content rendered on the left side of the toolbar. Typically a view-switching Select / SegmentControl followed by `<Filter>` and `<MoreFilter>` chips. |
| actions | `ToolbarActionProps[]` | no | - | Optional ghost / tertiary buttons rendered in the right cluster, in order, to the left of `primaryAction`. Toolbar renders these as `<Button>` components so the right cluster is design-system-pure by construction. Defaults each entry to `variant: 'ghost'`. |
| primaryAction | `ToolbarActionProps` | no | - | Optional single primary call-to-action rendered at the far right. Defaults to `variant: 'secondary'`. |
| children | `React.ReactNode` | no | - | Legacy pass-through. If `children` is set and the structured props above are not, the toolbar behaves as a single-slot flex container. |
| className | `string` | no | `''` | - |

```tsx
import { Toolbar } from 'pada-ds';

<Toolbar />
```

### Tooltip

`import { Tooltip } from 'pada-ds';`

A short description of an element, shown on hover and keyboard focus. The trigger gets `aria-describedby` while the tooltip is open. Also a namespace of compound parts: `Tooltip.Provider` (shared delays), `Tooltip.Root`, `Tooltip.Trigger`, `Tooltip.Content`, `Tooltip.Arrow`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| content | `React.ReactNode` | yes | - | Text (or short content) shown in the tooltip. Never put interactive content here. |
| children | `React.ReactElement` | yes | - | The element the tooltip describes. It must be focusable (a button, link or input). |
| position | `'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'left' \| 'right'` | no | `'top'` | Preferred side; flips when there is no room. |
| delayDuration | `number` | no | `300` | Hover time before the tooltip opens, in ms. Keyboard focus opens it immediately. |

```tsx
import { Tooltip } from 'pada-ds';

<Tooltip content="..."><span>...</span></Tooltip>
```

### Tooltip.Arrow

`import { Tooltip } from 'pada-ds';`

Arrow pointing at the trigger.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| asChild | `boolean` | no | - | Render your own arrow element (an SVG, usually). |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'span'>`.

```tsx
import { Tooltip } from 'pada-ds';

<Tooltip.Arrow />
```

### Tooltip.Content

`import { Tooltip } from 'pada-ds';`

The tooltip bubble, rendered in a portal and animated from the side that faces its trigger.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| container | `Element \| null` | no | - | Element to portal into. Defaults to `document.body`. |
| forceMount | `boolean` | no | - | Keep mounted while closed, for animation libraries that manage presence themselves. |
| onEscapeKeyDown | `(event: DismissEvent<KeyboardEvent>) => void` | no | - | Called on Escape. Prevent it to keep the tooltip open. |
| side | `Side` | no | - | Preferred side of the anchor. Flips to the opposite side when there is no room. |
| align | `Align` | no | - | Alignment along the side. |
| sideOffset | `number` | no | `6` | Gap between anchor and content, in px. |
| alignOffset | `number` | no | - | Shift along the alignment axis, in px. |
| avoidCollisions | `boolean` | no | - | Flip and shift to stay in the viewport. |
| collisionPadding | `number` | no | - | Distance to keep from the viewport edges, in px. |
| arrowPadding | `number` | no | - | Size of the arrow element, if any, so it stays inside rounded corners. |
| hideWhenDetached | `boolean` | no | - | Hide the content when its anchor scrolls out of view. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>`.

```tsx
import { Tooltip } from 'pada-ds';

<Tooltip.Content />
```

### Tooltip.Provider

`import { Tooltip } from 'pada-ds';`

Shares open delays between tooltips: moving from one trigger to the next skips the delay.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `ReactNode` | no | - | - |
| delayDuration | `number` | no | `700` | Hover time before a tooltip opens, in ms. |
| skipDelayDuration | `number` | no | `300` | After a tooltip closes, others open instantly for this long, in ms. |

```tsx
import { Tooltip } from 'pada-ds';

<Tooltip.Provider />
```

### Tooltip.Root

`import { Tooltip } from 'pada-ds';`

Holds the state for one tooltip. Renders no element. WAI-ARIA APG: Tooltip.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `ReactNode` | no | - | - |
| open | `boolean` | no | - | Controlled open state. |
| defaultOpen | `boolean` | no | `false` | Initial open state when uncontrolled. |
| onOpenChange | `(open: boolean) => void` | no | - | Called when the tooltip opens or closes. |
| delayDuration | `number` | no | - | Overrides the provider's hover delay, in ms. |
| disableHoverableContent | `boolean` | no | `false` | Close as soon as the pointer leaves the trigger, even towards the content. |

```tsx
import { Tooltip } from 'pada-ds';

<Tooltip.Root />
```

### Tooltip.Trigger

`import { Tooltip } from 'pada-ds';`

Element the tooltip describes. Opens on hover (after the delay) and immediately on keyboard focus; closes on leave, blur, Escape and pointer-down. Gets `aria-describedby` while open.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| asChild | `boolean` | no | - | Merge the trigger behaviour onto its only child (a button, link or icon button). |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'button'>`.

```tsx
import { Tooltip } from 'pada-ds';

<Tooltip.Trigger />
```

### Tree

`import { Tree } from 'pada-ds';`

A tree of items for file browsers, navigation and nested settings (WAI-ARIA APG Tree View). Up/Down move, Right expands or enters, Left collapses or goes up, Home/End jump, `*` expands the siblings, typing jumps to an item. Selection is `single`, `multiple` or `none`. Pass `items`, or compose `Tree.Root`, `Tree.Item`, `Tree.ItemRow`, `Tree.ItemLabel` and `Tree.Group` for custom rows.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| items | `TreeNode[]` | yes | - | The items, nested through `children`. |
| expanded | `string[]` | no | - | Controlled expanded items. |
| defaultExpanded | `string[]` | no | - | Initially expanded items when uncontrolled. |
| onExpandedChange | `(expanded: string[]) => void` | no | - | Called with the expanded items. |
| selectionMode | `SelectionMode` | no | - | `single` (default), `multiple` (Space or click toggles items) or `none` (navigation only). |
| value | `string[]` | no | - | Controlled selected items. |
| defaultValue | `string[]` | no | - | Initially selected items when uncontrolled. |
| onValueChange | `(value: string[]) => void` | no | - | Called with the selected items. |

Also accepts the props of `Omit<Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'ul'>, 'defaultValue' | 'onChange'>, 'children'>`.

```tsx
import { Tree } from 'pada-ds';

<Tree items={[]} />
```

### Tree.Group

`import { Tree } from 'pada-ds';`

The item's children.

No props.

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'ul'>`.

```tsx
import { Tree } from 'pada-ds';

<Tree.Group />
```

### Tree.Item

`import { Tree } from 'pada-ds';`

One item.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | `string` | yes | - | Identifies the item in `expanded` and `value`. |
| expandable | `boolean` | no | - | The item can expand (it has, or will load, child items). |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | - | - |

Also accepts the props of `Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'li'>, 'value'>`.

```tsx
import { Tree } from 'pada-ds';

<Tree.Item value="..." />
```

### Tree.ItemLabel

`import { Tree } from 'pada-ds';`

The item's name.

No props.

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'span'>`.

```tsx
import { Tree } from 'pada-ds';

<Tree.ItemLabel />
```

### Tree.ItemRow

`import { Tree } from 'pada-ds';`

The item's row: chevron (for expandable items), optional icon, then the label.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| icon | `string` | no | - | Built-in icon name shown before the label. |

Also accepts the props of `ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>`.

```tsx
import { Tree } from 'pada-ds';

<Tree.ItemRow />
```

### Tree.Root

`import { Tree } from 'pada-ds';`

The tree. Name it with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| expanded | `string[]` | no | - | Controlled expanded items. |
| defaultExpanded | `string[]` | no | - | Initially expanded items when uncontrolled. |
| onExpandedChange | `(expanded: string[]) => void` | no | - | Called with the expanded items. |
| selectionMode | `SelectionMode` | no | - | `single` (default), `multiple` (Space or click toggles items) or `none` (navigation only). |
| value | `string[]` | no | - | Controlled selected items. |
| defaultValue | `string[]` | no | - | Initially selected items when uncontrolled. |
| onValueChange | `(value: string[]) => void` | no | - | Called with the selected items. |

Also accepts the props of `Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'ul'>, 'defaultValue' | 'onChange'>`.

```tsx
import { Tree } from 'pada-ds';

<Tree.Root />
```

### UploadField

`import { UploadField } from 'pada-ds';`

A file picker with a drop zone. The zone is a real file input underneath, so keyboard users Tab to it and press Space or Enter to browse; dropped and picked files list below with their size, upload progress, status, and View and Remove actions.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | `string` | no | - | - |
| description | `string` | no | - | - |
| error | `string` | no | - | - |
| accept | `string` | no | - | - |
| multiple | `boolean` | no | `false` | - |
| maxSize | `number` | no | - | - |
| maxFiles | `number` | no | - | - |
| files | `UploadedFile[]` | no | - | - |
| onFilesChange | `(files: UploadedFile[]) => void` | no | - | - |
| onUpload | `(files: File[]) => Promise<void> \| void` | no | - | - |
| onView | `(file: UploadedFile) => void` | no | - | Called by a file's View button. By default the file opens in a new tab. |
| disabled | `boolean` | no | `false` | - |
| required | `boolean` | no | `false` | - |
| className | `string` | no | `''` | - |

```tsx
import { UploadField } from 'pada-ds';

<UploadField />
```
